name: emdr-therapy-platform
description: Distributed EMDR therapy platform with modular architecture

scripts.build:all: npm run build:client && npm run build:types
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.lint: npm run lint:server && npm run lint:client && npm run lint:shared
scripts.format: npm run format:server && npm run format:client
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd packages/server-core && npm install && cd packages/web-client && npm install && cd packages/shared-utils && npm install && cd packages/types && npm install
scripts.deploy: npm run build:all && cd packages/server-core && npm start
scripts.postversion: git add package.json VERSION.md && git commit -m "🔖 Release v$(node -e \"console.log(require('./package.json').version)\")" && git tag v$(node -e \"console.log(require('./package.json').version)\")
